objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution, archiving, revision, validity extension, override, reactivation and translation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Includes document type abbreviation, consecutive 4-digit number per type and title by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Part of the default document name format.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Can be automatically printed in the document by TAG technology and is documented for each released version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Can be automatically printed in the document by TAG technology and changes through statuses such as Released and Out Of Force.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Can be automatically printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the period of extended validity is calculated.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type; standard value is 3 years.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration can be defined for each document type; standard value is 10 years.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Registered author field; the creator of a document is automatically confirmed in it by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for the release process.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for the release process.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Participant for translation-related release assignment.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects existing user groups and persons in relation to email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects existing user groups and persons with regard to workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Differentiates documents for structuring and evaluation; selected when creating a new document object.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Included in the document name by default and not language-independent.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Can be defined for each document type.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: One or more templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure cover object to which external files or documents can be uploaded or on which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific data maintained in document properties, automatically or by the user.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Groups attributes and metadata according to their purpose in document properties.

objs.name: attribute
objs.description: Maintainable property such as References, IT applications, relevant companies or areas of validity.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant companies can be maintained via document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with master data.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, reader assignment and distribution.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user assigned to authorizations, workflow roles or distribution.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to user groups or persons for each document.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role available in document management, such as reader, author, checker, approver and translator.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role that can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role offered in author or co-author selection lists and given read and write permissions when assigned.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional change rights but no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for the document and its content and decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language and cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing used for approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement and translation processes.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and communicated by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created for release, revision, attachment changes, scheduled change proposals or reactivation.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document created by employees with author rights and managed without affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system 30 days before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request for invalidating a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents; only the Business Admin group is permitted to create it.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document by assigning user groups or persons for release information or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons or users in assigned user groups for a released document version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, release information, change proposals, validity extension or acknowledgement.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of released content checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Visibility target in a multi-client system for a document.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard filled using distribution groups per document.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type during creation of a new document object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the templates defined for a document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading external files or generating new documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_attribute
evts.description: Maintain attributes such as References, IT applications, relevant companies or areas of validity via document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web.

evts.name: change_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content.

evts.name: change_property
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_release_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or translation participants in the Control (release) category.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add additional information to a document by attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: modify_additional_information
evts.description: Modify additional information without creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document by attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving or archive it with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete the review task for the document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releasers complete the release task and finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A rejection during review cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A rejection during release cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so that it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or specified changes occur.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: inform_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity so the document remains valid in its current version and the valid until date is updated.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after validity is extended or the revised version is released.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a new revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a document determined to have no additional validity.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for processing a request for override after attachment of the request.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and set the last valid and approved version to Out Of Force status.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents and their attachments by withdrawing authorizations rather than physical deletion.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke all rights except for the archive group when documents are archived.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out Of Force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow after a request for reactivation is created.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation and a new document version is created.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists by assigning user groups or persons for each document.

evts.name: inform_by_email_on_release
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release from persons and users in assigned user groups.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through workflow support without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference to an original document when making a local addition in a client.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created based on a selected template.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
Document properties describe metadata for the document.
Attributes and metadata are grouped in categories.
Document properties contain maintainable attributes.
References are maintained via document properties to link documents to other objects.
Documents can be automatically linked with IT applications.
Relevant companies can be maintained for a document.
Areas of validity can be maintained for a document.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with master data.
User groups are assigned to documents for authorizations and distribution.
Persons are assigned to documents as participants or distribution recipients.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users/persons.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer and releaser attributes.
Users have system roles implemented in DHC VISION.
A registered author is maintained on the document.
Co-authors can be maintained on the document.
Reviewers can be maintained on the document.
Releasers can be maintained on the document.
Readers may view approved documents when authorized.
Translation participants are assigned in document properties.
Documents are processed by workflow-supported approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement and translation.
Workflow tasks are assigned to workflow participants.
Workflow participants complete release tasks with electronic signatures.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version and can be printed as document content.
Documents managed in versions have released, editing and invalidated versions.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and affect the associated version.
Attachments are subject to their own versioning.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding invalidated document.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning user groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Acknowledgement is requested and tracked for the current version of a document.
E-mail notifications inform users about release, workflow tasks and change proposals.
A translated language version belongs to a document.
For each document, visibility in clients can be specified.
Distribution groups in the distribution list fill user and role-specific dashboards.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.

o2e.description: A document is created in the system.
A document type is selected during document creation.
A document template is selected during document creation.
A pure object cover can be created.
External files or documents can be uploaded.
A new document can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.
Attributes are maintained via document properties.
Saved document is converted to PDF.
Converted document is displayed on the web.
Authorizations are assigned for a document.
Persons are assigned as release participants.
Participants are assigned in document properties.
A new document version is created.
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Request for validity extension is created.
Document is declared out of force.
Document is physically deleted after archive period.
Email notification informs assigned users on release.
Author team is notified about acknowledgements.
Reference to an original document is created.
